A word processor, a slide deck and a spreadsheet that don’t get in the way.

  • Split view: two or three documents next to each other, tabs grouped by colour

Plan

Tasks that live next to the work they belong to.

A project board with five views — Overview, Board, List, Table and Timeline. Tick a checklist item inside a document and it shows up on the board; add a task on the board and attach the document it’s about.

  • Sprints, releases, epics, reports and automations
  • Goals and key results can read a number straight from a sheet

FAQ

Questions, answered.

What can I create?

Four kinds of document: Notes for quick, linked writing; Pages for real documents with margins and page numbers (saved as .docx); Slides for presentations (.pptx); and Sheets for spreadsheets with formulas and charts (.xlsx). Tasks, a calendar, whiteboards, databases and goals tie them together.

Where is the documentation?

Right here on the website: the documentation has illustrated guides for every feature. The Help & Support button in the app opens it.

Where are my documents stored?

On your computer, in a regular folder inside your user data directory. Notes and folders are plain files, and documents you edit in Page view are saved as genuine .docx files. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Read more about privacy.

Which platforms does Doceo support?

Windows 10/11 (installer), macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux (AppImage, .deb and .rpm) are all supported. The same app and the same shortcuts everywhere.

Do I need an account or an internet connection?

No account and no connection. The only features that touch the network are ones you turn on yourself — subscribing to a calendar link or signing in to Microsoft 365.

Can I open and export Word files?

Yes. Documents are saved as .docx, and you can export a PDF or Word copy with the same page layout you see on screen. Open an existing .docx, .odt, .rtf, Markdown, text or HTML file straight from your disk, edit it in place and save back to the same file. Exports are saved wherever you choose, and the Exports tab in Files remembers where so you can open them again.

Does it sync with my Outlook, Google or iCloud calendar?

You can subscribe to a calendar by pasting its published .ics link. Events appear alongside your tasks and reminders and refresh automatically. Subscribed calendars are read-only.

Why does my computer warn me when I install it?

Doceo’s installers aren’t code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS show a one-time warning for apps from outside their stores. The install guide shows the quick way past it.
